notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 ordinary order and transportation control surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies default and per-instance order changes, interaction order changes, transportation changes and queries, invalid-handle boundaries, and delivered transport identity without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador ordinary order and transportation controls with FederateAmbassador delivery and confirmation callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador order/transport declarations and FederateAmbassador callbacks
